title: The last range follows the range above until edited
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, two ranges, Default 40% markup in both, tier A 10% off in both.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Point at Default's last range.
  5. Type 45 in Default's first range.
  6. Type 30 in Default's last range.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  9. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  10. Click Edit.
  11. Type 45 in Default's last range.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • A tooltip reads "Same as the rule above".

Step 5:

  • Default's last range now reads 45 as well.

Step 6:

  • Default's last range reads 30.

Step 7:

  • Matrix A saves.

Step 8:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 9:

  • Default reads 45% markup in the first range and 30% markup in the last.

Step 10:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 11:

  • Default's last range matches the range above again (45) and shows the "Same as the rule above" tooltip.
